presentation_or_repo_anchor: Derived from a local county proxy CSV, county polygons, and repo EMM-zone geometry
notes: Generated with python -m reVeal.public_data generate-land-value-proxy-features from a local county proxy CSV, a county polygon layer, and the repo EMM-zone geometry. A runnable representative bundle can now be staged with python -m reVeal.public_data stage-example-bundle public_land_value_proxy --repo-root ., which writes example inputs plus a README with the validated command. This is a public approximation because county valuation methods are not harmonized nationally, so the state_land_value_index is only directly comparable within a state.

presentation_or_repo_anchor: Derived from a local county wage-and-price proxy CSV, county polygons, and repo EMM-zone geometry
notes: Generated with python -m reVeal.public_data generate-construction-cost-proxy-features from a local county proxy CSV, a county polygon layer, and the repo EMM-zone geometry. A runnable representative bundle can now be staged with python -m reVeal.public_data stage-example-bundle public_construction_cost_proxy --repo-root ., which writes example inputs plus a README with the validated command. The proxy formula multiplies construction_worker_mean_wage_usd by regional_price_parity_index / 100 and carries a construction_cost_relative_index normalized to the national mean. This is a public approximation and is explicitly non-equivalent to data center dollars-per-MW construction cost.
